name: desktop_screen_wait_for_image
description:
Poll the screen until a template image appears, then return its location.

`timeoutMs` controls how long to wait before throwing (default: 5000 ms).
`intervalMs` sets the poll frequency (default: 500 ms).
`confidence` sets the minimum similarity threshold (0–1, default: 0.8).
Requires `@nut-tree-fork/template-matcher` to be installed.

templatePath.description: Absolute path to the PNG template image to wait for

region.description: Restrict search to this screen region
